decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already fully captures the necessary effect on Shopify publication timing; no additional or edited Event is needed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the concurrent working-list and publication workflow; no further state change is required.
The source changes when selected products are published, not the product-selection criteria or the requirement to add selected products to the working list.
The source concerns ecommerce product-listing timing and does not change Airbnb lead follow-up behavior.
The source does not concern CRM document completion, location, or client visibility.
The instruction changes the workflow within a product-listing task but does not alter the general assignment set, deadline, or recurring completion rules.
The working list in this source is the ecommerce product list, not the spreadsheet used to track interested Airbnb leads.
The source specifies product-publication timing and does not change the fallback rule for independently selecting other available work.
The source does not discuss or change the daily Airbnb host-outreach cadence.
The source concerns ecommerce product publication and does not change the content bank's artifact, use, or deadline.
Adding ecommerce products to a working list is unrelated to storing completed task artifacts and supporting links in linked Google documents.
The incidental word 'list' does not connect the product-listing instruction to Bitwarden credential visibility.
